details:
Can I use a Leap Motion controller to track hands in run mode without using VR helmets and without connecting my smartphone as a helmet? Interested in using Leap Motion without SteamVR. I would like to use it in Desktop mode. Control the character on the keyboard or gamepad and, if necessary, stretch out your hands and visualize them in the game.
So that VRchat can understand where Leap Motion is, you could do 2 modes (1 on the head and 2 on the table). I am sure that this is not easy to implement, but I think a lot of people are interested in this issue. This will allow users with weaker PCs to use VRchat features without expensive virtual reality kits.
(I apologize in advance for my English. Google translator helped me)
